notes: v3.0.42 - Retry polish, audited: the retry that brings athenaOne forward now refuses to act when you are working OUTSIDE Chrome (so it can never raise a window under your typing), and if you switch tabs while a retry is reading, your choice wins - MLS never yanks you back. A per-patient wait counter could previously leak between patients and shorten the next chart read; it is now bound to each request. Everything from v3.0.41 remains: the foreground-assisted retry that finally completes visit bodies, welded-name imports, settled-empty days, self-healing updated tabs, phantom-proof day completion, strict note-write verification with rollback, and 160k-character charts. Requires Chrome 116+.
